scope: Intentional run reference semantics alignment with accepted C17

observations: C17 _resolve requires catalogue reference.snapshot_id to match payload snapshot; artifacts retain an independent reference snapshot validated by the trusted resolver against owner, ID and hash.
C17 _key hashes the complete canonical reference object; identity therefore includes kind, id and snapshot_id.

changes: Allow a retained artifact reference from a different snapshot while retaining exact original scientific run binding. Catalogue references remain constrained to that binding snapshot.
Define duplicate identity using all three C17 reference fields; different artifact snapshots remain distinct and exact duplicates still fail.
new_acceptance_cases: Cross-snapshot retained artifact attachments and pins survive deep freeze, caller mutation and linked continuation while the original run binding remains fixed.
Same artifact kind/ID with two retained snapshots is permitted; an exact kind/ID/snapshot duplicate is rejected.
limitations: No production execution, model calls, network calls, scientific computation, scientific approval, retained artifact creation or real evidence content reading
C20 supplies production run transport, server authorization and durable execution
C21 supplies retained artifact content and final answer/evidence integration
Root owns composer submit wiring and interactive browser/keyboard/mobile verification; SSR checks alone do not establish those gates
